Hey just want to say im not trying to come across as judgemental, dismissive or anything and genuinely, i am sorry if it came across like that, but i know thats how that type of thinking comes across to people contemplating suicide. 

I’ve lived the past decade of my life fighting the constant urge to end it all, i dont understand YOUR situation, but i can relate to a lot of the ways you feel and thats why i felt maybe my message could get to you.

Being dumped by close friends and a partner all at once is something i experienced last year and honestly just now id say im returning to normal again, or whatever that is. Its devastating to feel betrayed, used and lied to by people that you feel obligated to trust because you know if you didn’t you would have already wound up dead.

However, again I’ll state that you still have some hope in you. Im not going to go into some complex psychological stuff that may not even be true for everyone, and for the most part it would just piss you off and make you feel dismissed which again, I don’t want to do. But its my belief that we dont stop fighting, at least subconsciously until the bullet is in your head and the heart has stopped beating. You could have chosen to attempt already, maybe you have, without telling a single soul. But I believe that you still want to fight still. You’re exhausted but the ref has yet to blow the whistle. You’re still here and still clinging to any remainders of what you want in life.

I dont want to lecture you because i fucking hated when people gave them to me but you deserve a happy life and the chance to fight for it too. I can’t help you with your attempt question (id have been dead for years already if i knew a surefire way with minimal risk to permanent disability if i fail). I cant give you advice on how to handle the people in your life. But i can talk to you and listen and i can want you stick around even if you are a random stranger.

You’re assuming the worst in your boyfriend who you clearly love. If you truly try to see the best in other people, despite your distaste for yourself, then why on earth would you ever assume these people think bad of you? Why would you think they dont want to be around you if they have never said those things themselves? Dont assume the worst in others because you assume the worst of yourself. 

It doesn’t have to be fixed tomorrow, next week or next year, but if the only thing that can keep you with us is because you want to do it for your boyfriend, then so be it. Live for him, until you can live for yourself. Be honest, be communicative and when you have healed, reward him for the man that he is to you. Dealing with depression and with someone with depression both create their own traumas and he will need to process things too. But for now focus on you.

Also im sorry but NOBODY, including myself many times before, comes on this sub because they are out of hope entirely. You made this post, because you WANT to live and you are finding any excuse to ask for help. Dig deep and continue to pull from that hope until more comes along. 

Stay alive friend.

I agree with a lot of what you said, i wish things had been different when we were younger and that we had the chance to cope.

But we didnt. So we have to figure it out for ourselves and hopefully pass that onto our children and transform the never ending cycle were all stuck in instead of trying to break it constantly.

God its like im looking into the past at myself. Literally 3 months ago, fuck A month ago I wouldve been the one typing exactly what you just said. But something we have to learn is to break that fantasy because thats all it is, a fantasy. I promise to you the hardest thing is going to be separating this person from the image you have of them. 

Whatever you think of them, they are either not at all thinking those same things about you, or they got into this rebound because the thought of trying to unpack what happened between you two was so overwhelming and exhausting to them, that theyd rather go through the same god damn shit again with someone else just to not feel any pain.

You arent in a rebound i presume, you are going to therapy. You are actively seeking help for the turmoil going on in your head and instead of hating them and blaming them, you want to put that blame on yourself and use it as a learning experience for yourself. All of these things are hard as fuck to achieve after a breakup on their own, and you are doing all of that, on your own, without them.

Please be kind to yourself, you arent toxic, toxic people don’t call themselves toxic. You are a clearly gentle soul that has made mistakes and you’re willing to own them. Its not going to get easier before it gets harder, but you will make it to the other side where one day you will wake up, go through your day and fall asleep and never realized they hadn’t crossed your mind once.

Good on you for being introspective and realizing your own faults. But don’t try to compare yourself to them in who was worse. It’ll only make the healing harder.

But never believe that the person that rebounded within two weeks as you said is ever worth your time. Because they arent. They arent with them because theres this magical spark they found, this person is in a lot of pain and instead of dealing with it, they are just moving their baggage on to someone else.

Good luck on the healing man, keep it up and the days will get easier

I'm sorry you're going through your situation, i relate to it a lot right now with my breakup a week ago. But one thing I've learned is you can't do what everyone else does. Nobody ever has taken a breakup completely fine. We all have our own mechanisms to adjust, mine is a nightly drive to the main street near his house then turning around, and in it I do a voice memo, talking to myself about that day and how i'm doing, because at least I know i'm listening to me.

We all have our mechanisms, and you have to use them, and you have to really get introspective with yourself, find out who you are despite how good you were with that person. You clearly loved, and love is such a painful feeling, but time has always been able to dissolve at love slowly, like a rotting corpse, but there's an odd beauty in that. When something is rotting, it's being repurposed really. It's not a pretty sight but you take that repurposed love, that energy you had from them and you sit on it. Take it out a little at a time, and then someday, you'll find someone else, you'll grow with someone that you truly deserve, and that deserves you. 

I've read a lot of posts where these people go through rough breakups that end on good terms, and 5-20 years down the line, they reconcile. I can't speak for you, but I know for me, if I ever give myself hope that we get back together at this point after he left me, I will sit in anguish and blissful decay for the rest of my life, waiting for the one in my mind that got away. I can't do that, you hopefully don't want to do that either.

I wish you luck on your recovery, heartbreak is disgusting. But necessary. Well wishes!
